input.reason: Audited slugify/slugify.js against slugify/SPEC.md. Rule 1 (lowercase) and rule 3 (drop non [a-z0-9-] chars) are met. Rules 2, 4, and 5 are violated with concrete failing inputs verified by running the code. These are implementation bugs requiring code changes, so routing as repair work rather than fixing directly (this task is review-only).

children.title: Fix slugify: implement missing hyphen-run collapsing (SPEC rule 4)
children.purpose: slugify/slugify.js has no logic to collapse consecutive '-' characters into one, violating SPEC.md rule 4. Verified: slugify("a   b") returns "a---b" instead of "a-b"; slugify("a--b") returns "a--b" instead of "a-b".
children.completion_criteria: slugify collapses any run of one or more '-' (whether from literal hyphens or converted whitespace) into a single '-'. Add regression tests covering multi-space input and literal repeated hyphens. Existing tests in slugify.test.js still pass.

children.title: Fix slugify: strip trailing hyphens (SPEC rule 5)
children.purpose: slugify/slugify.js only strips leading '-' via a while loop on out.charAt(0); it never strips trailing '-'. Verified: slugify("trail ") returns "trail-" instead of "trail", violating SPEC.md rule 5 (no leading or trailing '-').
children.completion_criteria: slugify output has no trailing '-' for any input, including inputs whose trailing whitespace/hyphens produce one. Add a regression test for trailing whitespace/hyphens. Existing tests in slugify.test.js still pass.

children.title: Fix slugify: treat all whitespace as SPEC rule 2 requires
children.purpose: slugify/slugify.js only converts ' ', '\t', '\n' to '-'; other whitespace characters (e.g. '\r', '\f', '\v', Unicode spaces) fall through to the drop branch instead of becoming '-', violating SPEC.md rule 2 ('any whitespace becomes "-"'). Verified: slugify("a\rb") returns "ab" instead of "a-b".
children.completion_criteria: slugify converts any whitespace character (per a reasonable definition, e.g. matching /\s/) to '-', not just space/tab/newline. Add a regression test using '\r' (and ideally another whitespace variant). Existing tests in slugify.test.js still pass.
